headline: Learn the 12 cranial nerves in order
stat_note: Ooh, Ooh, Ooh To Touch And Feel Very Good Velvet. Such Heaven!
body: Olfactory, Optic, Oculomotor, Trochlear, Trigeminal, Abducens, Facial, Vestibulocochlear, Glossopharyngeal, Vagus, Spinal accessory, Hypoglossal.

headline: Babies have more bones than adults do
stat_note: bones at birth vs about 206 in adults
body: Many newborn bones fuse together as the skeleton grows, so the count drops to about 206 to 213 in adults.

headline: About 480 million alveoli fill your lungs
stat_note: average alveoli in both adult lungs
body: These tiny air sacs are where oxygen passes into the blood. In the study, counts ranged from 274 to 790 million.
source: Source: Ochs et al., Am J Respir Crit Care Med, 2004
